'''Black_wraith Profit What Profit''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Black_wraith]]
* '''Published:''' 22 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This...|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' You Can Either Profit By This...
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Profit Black_wraith LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is the best Reb. deck that i could come up with. Feedback appreciated.

The published list has 53 cards.

== Strategy ==

Get jar jar and i did it out immediatly and start a podrace(You can always choose not to accept a destiny and sit a 23 untill the force is needed). Hope you get a good hand with a captive persuit and maybe a couple of jedi, Sit back wait for the opponent to drain you a while, Lay the smackdown at the chamber, and don't for get to play captive pursuit so you can release Han, retrive your force. Spread out a little and drain and damage them, but dont for get to retrieve the other 10 force from the podrace and I Did It.
